# DiffLab

> DiffLab is a free, browser-based diff and comparison tool for text, code, JSON, spreadsheets,
> images, and documents. Parsing, comparing, and rendering all happen client-side — nothing is
> uploaded unless the user explicitly chooses to share a link.

## Tools

- [Text & Code Diff Checker](https://difflab.zeeshanai.cloud/compare/text): Live side-by-side and unified diffs with syntax highlighting across 40+ languages, word/character/line precision, ignore whitespace/case/regex, per-chunk merge and revert, and unified-patch export.
- [JSON Diff Checker](https://difflab.zeeshanai.cloud/compare/json): Compares two JSON documents with inline parse-error markers, pretty-printing, optional recursive key sorting, and a semantic summary of added, removed, and changed key paths.
- [Excel & CSV Diff Checker](https://difflab.zeeshanai.cloud/compare/excel): Compares XLSX, XLS, CSV, TSV, and ODS spreadsheets sheet-by-sheet, aligning rows by position or a chosen key column, with cell-level highlighting.
- [Image Diff Checker](https://difflab.zeeshanai.cloud/compare/image): Compares two images via slider, fade, onion-skin, or pixel-level difference modes; mismatched dimensions are padded, never cropped.
- [Document Diff Checker](https://difflab.zeeshanai.cloud/compare/document): Compares PDF and Word documents with a page/paragraph marker gutter, using the same diff engine as the text tool.

## Pages

- [Home](https://difflab.zeeshanai.cloud/): Landing page introducing all five comparison tools.
- [Contact](https://difflab.zeeshanai.cloud/contact): Feedback, bug reports, and feature requests.
- [Privacy](https://difflab.zeeshanai.cloud/privacy): What is and isn't stored, and the client-side-by-default privacy model.

## Notes

- Free to use, no account required, no usage limits.
- Nothing is uploaded unless the user clicks "Save & share"; small diffs are encoded directly into the URL, larger ones are stored and served back only to holders of the resulting link.
- Saved diffs live at /d/{id}, are ephemeral (expire per the sharer's choice), and are intentionally excluded from indexing — not canonical content.
